release_notes: Build 178 delivers the real Instagram Business Login connection flow instead of sending the user to Instagram setup documentation.
Build 178 opens Instagram sign-in, handles the local OAuth callback, exchanges the authorization code for a long-lived access token, and saves it securely.
Build 178 keeps the existing Facebook Page approval flow and validates the connected Instagram account before Autopilot uses it.
Build 178 keeps the deferred startup phases, reduced cleanup passes, and inactive Autopilot timer improvements.
